## `client.content`

{class}`~plone_client.managers.content.ContentManager`.

Content items, through the content endpoints of `plone.restapi`.

### `client.content.get`

Serialization of an item.

See {meth}`~plone_client.managers.content.ContentManager.get`.

Calls `GET /news/release-6-2` ([`plone.restapi` documentation](https://6.docs.plone.org/plone.restapi/docs/source/endpoints/content-types.html)).

`````{tab-set}
:sync-group: service-example

````{tab-item} Python
:sync: python

```python
client.content.get("/news/release-6-2")
```
````

````{tab-item} Command line
:sync: cli

```shell
plone-client get /news/release-6-2 -f @id,@type,title,review_state
```

```json
{
  "@id": "http://localhost:8080/Plone/news/release-6-2",
  "@type": "News Item",
  "title": "Release 6.2 is out",
  "review_state": "published"
}
```
````

````{tab-item} HTTP
:sync: http

```http
GET /Plone/++api++/news/release-6-2 HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:8080
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46YWRtaW4=
```

```shell
curl -i -X GET http://localhost:8080/Plone/++api++/news/release-6-2 -H 'accept: application/json' -u admin:admin
```
````
`````

```json
{
  "@id": "http://localhost:8080/Plone/news/release-6-2",
  "@type": "News Item",
  "review_state": "published",
  "title": "Release 6.2 is out"
}
```

This shows only `@id`, `@type`, `title`, `review_state`.

#### Expand a component

`expand` puts the answer of another service inside the item.

Calls `GET /news/release-6-2` ([`plone.restapi` documentation](https://6.docs.plone.org/plone.restapi/docs/source/endpoints/content-types.html)).

`````{tab-set}
:sync-group: service-example

````{tab-item} Python
:sync: python

```python
client.content.get("/news/release-6-2", expand="breadcrumbs")["@components"]
```
````

````{tab-item} Command line
:sync: cli

```shell
plone-client get /news/release-6-2 --expand breadcrumbs -f title
```

```json
{
  "title": "Release 6.2 is out"
}
```
````

````{tab-item} HTTP
:sync: http

```http
GET /Plone/++api++/news/release-6-2?expand=breadcrumbs HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:8080
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46YWRtaW4=
```

```shell
curl -i -X GET 'http://localhost:8080/Plone/++api++/news/release-6-2?expand=breadcrumbs' -H 'accept: application/json' -u admin:admin
```
````
`````

```json
{
  "breadcrumbs": {
    "@id": "http://localhost:8080/Plone/news/release-6-2/@breadcrumbs",
    "items": [
      {
        "@id": "http://localhost:8080/Plone/news",
        "title": "News"
      },
      {
        "@id": "http://localhost:8080/Plone/news/release-6-2",
        "title": "Release 6.2 is out"
      }
    ],
    "root": "http://localhost:8080/Plone"
  }
}
```

This shows only `breadcrumbs`.
